condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "NJ" streq } over if
apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "NJ" streq } over if

action_details.action_postfix: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

action_details.action_postfix: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no filing required; No nexus - zero tax and refund payments

policy_statement.policy_description: NJ filing required due to physical presence
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "NJ filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state). Reference: NJ Rev. Stat. § 54:10A-2 (Imposition of tax), NJ Division of Taxation Technical Bulletin TB-78, NJ P.L. 2018, c.48 (Corporation Business Tax Act amendments)"

policy_statement.policy_description: NJ filing required due to economic nexus
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "NJ filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 in NJ gross receipts OR 200 transactions. Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), NJ Rev. Stat. § 54:10A-2, NJ Division of Taxation Economic Nexus Guidance (2018)"

policy_statement.policy_description: No NJ nexus - no filing requirement
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "No NJ nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded."

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NJ state additions and subtractions; Calculate NJ state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_postfix:
// Calculate NJ state additions and subtractions 0.0 /additions xdef 0.0 /subtractions xdef apportionment.state_additions additions xdef apportionment.state_subtractions subtractions xdef
// Store NJ entire net income for surtax calculation result.nj_entire_net_income apportionment.state_taxable_income xdef

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - zero adjustments; No nexus - no state adjustments calculated
action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no state adjustments apportionment.state_additions 0.0 xdef apportionment.state_subtractions 0.0 xdef result.nj_entire_net_income 0.0 xdef

policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "NJ state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income. Result is NJ 'entire net income' - the base for Corporation Business Tax. Additions may include: Interest on U.S. government obligations (NJ Rev. Stat. § 54:10A-4(k)), IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback, Certain depreciation adjustments. Subtractions may include: Interest on NJ state and local government bonds, NJ net operating loss deduction (separate from federal NOL). Reference: NJ Form CBT-100 Instructions, NJ Rev. Stat. § 54:10A-4, NJ Technical Bulletin TB-65"

No nexus - no tax; No NJ nexus - zero tax and refund payments
Nexus but no taxable income; No NJ taxable income - zero tax and refund payments

policy_statement.policy_description: NJ state corporate income tax calculation
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "NJ state corporate income tax calculation: 1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28], 2. Apportioned to NJ: × [Apportionment %], 3. State additions: + [Additions], 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions], 5. NJ entire net income: = [Result], 6. NJ base tax rate: × 9%, 7. NJ income tax: = [Tax before credits], 8. NJ credits: - [Credits], 9. NJ tax liability (before surtax): = [Tax]. Note: 2.5% surtax calculated separately if entire net income > $1,000,000. Total effective rate for large corporations: 11.5% (9% + 2.5% surtax). For corporations with allocated net income between $50K-$100K, rates are 6.5% or 7.5%. This implementation uses the standard 9% rate for income > $100K. Reference: NJ Form CBT-100 Instructions, NJ Rev. Stat. § 54:10A-5, NJ Rev. Stat. § 54:10A-5.5"

policy_statement.policy_description: NJ Corporation Business Tax surtax for large corporations
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "NJ Corporation Business Tax surtax applies to large corporations. Surtax Calculation: NJ entire net income: [State taxable income], Surtax threshold: $1,000,000, Surtax rate: × 2.5%, Surtax amount: = [Surtax], Total NJ tax: Base tax (9%) + Surtax (2.5%) = 11.5% effective rate. The surtax applies to the ENTIRE net income, not just the amount over $1M. Example: Entire net income: $2,000,000, Base tax (9%): $180,000, Surtax (2.5%): $50,000, Total tax: $230,000 (11.5% effective rate). Reference: NJ Rev. Stat. § 54:10A-5.5, NJ Form CBT-100 Schedule A, NJ P.L. 2018, c.48"
"No NJ surtax - entire net income does not exceed $1,000,000 threshold. Only the 9% base rate applies."
"No NJ surtax - no NJ nexus or no taxable income."

policy_statement.policy_description: No NJ surtax - no positive tax base
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "No NJ surtax - no positive tax base."
